fusions.name: Snagged and Reeled
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Torn Free
fusions.desc: A tearing strike with your weapon that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one. It then leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Worm on the Tongue
fusions.desc: Sets a lure on the ground near the nearest enemy. It waits up to 12 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 20 damage in a snap around it.

fusions.name: Line Held Taut
fusions.desc: Against afflicted enemies, your armour rises by 10%.
